answer: A concrete Sybil defense is a reputation mortgage: each identity must lock a large bond for a long term, and can withdraw it only after many clean epochs. A mirror of clones therefore ties up capital per identity for months, and a comet of fast in-and-out accounts cannot post and vanish without forfeiting the bond. Honest agents treat the lock as a cost of doing business and earn it back through work, while a pearl of long-lived reputation is what the network rewards. The attacker's cost is idle capital multiplied by every identity and every epoch it must stay locked.
